  secure auth, RBAC and Firebase push notifications.

## Flagship project: EDITH — local-first personal AI companion (macOS)

A 100% local, persistent AI companion — not a chatbot. An always-alive Python daemon holds
state, memory and an event-priority ladder; the 9B-parameter model (Ollama) loads only when
cognition is required. Hybrid Swift/SwiftUI + Python architecture over a Unix socket.
Verified measurements:

- 1,596-test suite (~10 s) with runtime liveness ledgers; a registry witness instrument
  found 22 of 155 registry rows the tests never actually reached.
- Cold start 20.7 s to first token; 0.36–0.77 s warm; idle footprint under 1 GB on an
  18 GB machine; a lifecycle redesign cut measured swap from 17.8 GB to 7.3 GB.
- Measured base-model swap: 10/10 instruction gate, 14/14 held-out honesty suite
  (previous base: 9/14), 0 fabrications across 16 hand-inspected replies.
- Independent local replication of Anthropic's 2025 agentic-misalignment methodology:
  24 agentic runs + 12 comprehension probes, scoring pre-registered and unit-tested before
  the first run, four-layer containment, every scorer flag checked against the full
  transcript (all 3 were false positives), and a published re-analysis with 12 documented
  corrections, including the retraction of a finding that rested on a single run.
  Write-up: https://claude.ai/artifact/7TTKjre9CBnbJv1ziY4zhn
- LoRA fine-tuning on Apple MLX: rank 8, 0.06% trainable parameters (5.4M of 8.95B),
  held-out validation loss 3.89 → 2.73, versioned adapters with one-command rollback,
  enforced 0.30 word-overlap leakage gate between training and held-out sets.
- Containment-first perception: the model can never choose a URL; SSRF validation;
  ten adversarial injection images through the vision pipeline produced zero stored facts
  and zero executed directives.

## Other projects

- **SentinelAI**: production multi-agent platform
  scoring geopolitical & market risk for Gold, Oil, S&P 500, BTC, ETH — 7-agent LangGraph
  pipeline with Monte Carlo + GARCH risk modeling, Qdrant semantic news search over
  GDELT/FRED, sub-30 s end-to-end, with rate-limit handling (429 back-off honoring
  Retry-After) on Groq. Talan bootcamp, team project (winner).
- **ScribeAI**: meeting intelligence — real-time diarized transcription (EN/FR/AR/Tunisian,
  ElevenLabs Scribe API), 9-step AI analysis pipeline on a local LLM (Ollama), RAG over
  ChromaDB, auto-generated Mermaid architecture diagrams. Talan bootcamp, team project
  (winner).
- **ZK-Attest** (https://github.com/ElyesDarouich/zk-attest): privacy-preserving credential
  verification — Groth16 zero-knowledge proofs (Circom/snarkjs), W3C Verifiable Credentials,
  ERC-5192 soulbound trust chain on Hyperledger Besu, RFC 9162 transparency log.
- **Claude Hive** (https://github.com/ElyesDarouich/claude-hive): coordination layer for
  multiple Claude Code agents — live awareness, formal task delegation, secret-scrubbed
  event streaming over Supabase Realtime, seven MCP tools.
- **Agentic Valley** (https://github.com/ElyesDarouich/Agentic-Valley): VSCode extension
  rendering multi-agent orchestration as a living pixel-art office — a main agent plus six
  specialised Claude Agent SDK agents.
- Earlier: WABAG desktop apps (Electron), SquadLink, Dialex (iOS), Nomadly (Flutter),
  Riftpedia (SwiftUI).
